purpose: Machine-readable handover for resuming large-scale full-text coding after the OpenAlex-to-Zenodo acquisition period.

coding_rules_locked_for_next_round.comparator: Only genuine focal comparator; do not force survivor-versus-mortality contrasts into comparator.
coding_rules_locked_for_next_round.production_vs_life_stage: production_stage and fish_life_stage are independent; harvest is not a fish life stage; Adult grow-out is a production stage.
coding_rules_locked_for_next_round.life_stage_inference: When not explicit, infer only Juvenile or Adult from suitable age/mass/development evidence matching the species farmed growth trajectory; otherwise NOT FOUND. Do not infer other life stages from age/mass.
coding_rules_locked_for_next_round.research_question_objectives: Search the whole document; abstract/Introduction are useful but not exclusive. Explicit aims/objectives/questions elsewhere are acceptable.
coding_rules_locked_for_next_round.array_completeness: All array fields must remain arrays; when applicable but unsupported after active searching use ["NOT FOUND"].
coding_rules_locked_for_next_round.validation: Warnings are diagnostic/non-fatal unless the workflow explicitly fails.
coding_rules_locked_for_next_round.ontology: Use only topic_ontology_v3.csv codes; reporting terminology comes from its exact hierarchy_path.
coding_rules_locked_for_next_round.multiple_studies: Require strong evidence of independently structured eligible studies/components; multiple treatments/timepoints/outcomes alone do not qualify.

acquisition.schedule: Daily OpenAlex full-text acquisition, maximum 100 content files per batch.

zenodo_coding_pipeline.stop: A manually started run processes uncompleted deposited Zenodo records sequentially until all are exhausted or the user cancels/stops the GitHub Actions run.
zenodo_coding_pipeline.record_unit: One Zenodo record at a time.
zenodo_coding_pipeline.paper_unit: One TEI full text at a time within the selected Zenodo record.
zenodo_coding_pipeline.concurrency: Only one Zenodo coding run may operate at once.
zenodo_coding_pipeline.resume: The cumulative architecture is consulted before coding; completed OpenAlex IDs are skipped.
zenodo_coding_pipeline.checkpoint_rule: After every successfully coded paper, update cumulative_coding.json and coding_architecture.json and commit/push both to GitHub before proceeding to the next paper.
zenodo_coding_pipeline.failure_boundary: If an annotation is not produced, the workflow stops before advancing to the next paper.

artifacts.checkpoint_artifact: Current annotations, downloaded archive and cumulative/provenance JSON state.

design_decision: Do not create a separate bulk ingestion workflow. Zenodo is intentionally ingested one record at a time by the existing AI coding pipeline; persistence is cumulative and provenance is explicit.
before_full_scale_run: Confirm all expected Zenodo records are deposited and present in fulltext_batch_registry.csv.
Confirm the master CSV contains stable OpenAlex IDs and DOIs.
Manually run the workflow on a deliberately selected Zenodo record as an end-to-end smoke test.
Inspect the first run's provenance, checkpoint commits, cumulative JSON and 90-day artifact before allowing large-scale processing.
Do not change the frozen coding prompt/schema/ontology unless a genuine systematic coding error is demonstrated.

baseline.status: Useful baseline only; produced before the final completeness/NOT FOUND instruction and therefore not the benchmark for that change.
baseline.visual_report: 20-study categorical/ontology visualisation PDF was produced separately.
